inputs.name: sheet
inputs.sql: SELECT r.id AS id, (SELECT value FROM facet_values WHERE record_id = r.id AND key = 'region') AS region FROM records r WHERE r.id = ?1

inputs.name: lines
inputs.sql: SELECT l.source_id AS id, COALESCE((SELECT value_num FROM facet_values WHERE record_id = l.source_id AND key = 'amount_minor'), 0) AS amount_minor FROM links l JOIN records r ON r.id = l.source_id WHERE l.target_id = ?1 AND l.relationship = 'line_of' ORDER BY l.source_id

inputs.name: totals
inputs.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE((SELECT value_num FROM facet_values WHERE record_id = l.source_id AND key = 'amount_minor'), 0)), 0) AS total FROM links l JOIN records r ON r.id = l.source_id WHERE l.target_id = ?1 AND l.relationship = 'line_of'

inputs.name: rate
inputs.sql: SELECT r.id AS id, (SELECT value_num FROM facet_values WHERE record_id = r.id AND key = 'rate_bp') AS rate_bp FROM records r WHERE r.type = 'TaxRate' AND (SELECT value FROM facet_values WHERE record_id = r.id AND key = 'region') = ?1 LIMIT 1
